sentences.japanese: とても暑くて、車のボンネットで卵が焼けるよ。
sentences.english: It's so hot that you could cook an egg on the hood of a car.

sentences.japanese: 君の煙草の火でコートに焼け焦げができた。
sentences.english: You burnt a hole in my coat with your cigarette.

sentences.japanese: 強い日差しで彼の背中はひどく焼けた。
sentences.english: Due to the intense sunlight, his back was sunburnt.

sentences.japanese: 去年の春、料理教室に通って、パンの焼き方を覚えました。
sentences.english: I took a cooking class last spring and learned to bake bread.

sentences.japanese: 学校は焼けて灰になった。
sentences.english: Our school was reduced to ashes.
